entities.summary: Dastur Khan's Mosque, also known as Paththarwali Masjid, is a mosque in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat. India. The structure is a Monument of National Importance. Dastur Khan's Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1486. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
